verdict.rationale: Evidence shows ClickHouse offers an MCP server so external AI assistants/agents can connect to and query ClickHouse, and CLI tools for humans, but there is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant embedded inside ClickHouse itself that a user can delegate tasks to. missing for 10: any built-in/native AI assistant UI or feature within ClickHouse (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL copilot), evidence of task delegation to an internal assistant.
